messages.content: What is the final velocity for an object in free fall after 5 seconds, given the gravity g and initial velocity 0?

function.name: calculateFinalVelocity
function.description: This function calculates the final velocity of an object in free fall after a certain time, taking into account the acceleration due to gravity and the initial velocity. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

time.description: The time in seconds for which the object has been in free fall. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity, typically in m/s^2. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

initialVelocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s at the start of the free fall. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

message.content:
The final velocity \(v_f\) after a time \(t\) when starting from rest (\(u=0\)) is simply

\[
v_f = u + g\,t = 0 + g \times 5 = 5g .
\]

So the object will have a speed of **\(5g\) m/s** after 5 seconds.
